editions.attribution: J. S. Bach, Partita No. 1, BWV 825, I. Praeludium, bars 1–6. Typeset by Carl Bolstad, based on Bach-Gesellschaft; Mutopia-2006/08/21-474. The typesetter dedicated this edition to the public domain. Excerpt and three-part separation adapted from the source LilyPond/MIDI.
editorialNotes: The source explicitly defines TopVoice, MiddleVoice and BottomVoice. MiddleVoice crosses staves; its colour follows the notated voice, not the hand or pitch register.
Published MIDI merges the three notated voices into two staff tracks. The source-based separation is checked against all source MIDI events in bars 1–6.
The source MIDI tempo is eighth = 80, equivalent to quarter = 40. The six-bar excerpt lasts 36 seconds at this edition playback tempo.
The upper F at the end of bar 6 is tied into bar 7 in the complete movement; it is clipped at the excerpt boundary.
Prall ornament marks are not expanded into extra performed notes in the source MIDI.
